production_entries: cmd/facade/main.go:80 constructs the Telegram repository with telegram.New(cfg.Telegram, telegram.NoBusinessUpdates); cmd/facade/main.go:94 builds the application facade via facade.New(telegramRepo); cmd/facade/main.go:109-111 builds the gRPC transport and calls pb.RegisterFacadeGRPCServer(s, grpcTransport), which is the production registration of the generated FacadeGRPC server including the new unary ListMessageFiles.

internal/transport/grpc/pb/facade.proto:8 defines service FacadeGRPC; internal/transport/grpc/pb/facade.proto:26 adds the single new unary rpc ListMessageFiles to the 17 baseline declarations. api/proto/facade.proto remains the tracked mode 120000 relative symlink (blob e7a8db424bf9ead3f69b52ae76ad08243b47177a), not a second proto source.
upstream_callers: A remote gRPC client calls /pb.FacadeGRPC/ListMessageFiles. The production handler is Transport.ListMessageFiles at internal/transport/grpc/message_files.go:138, which validates request IDs before any application call (internal/transport/grpc/message_files.go:139-141) and only then delegates to the application operation at internal/transport/grpc/message_files.go:142.
downstream_dependencies: The transport depends on the facadeService partial interface declared at internal/transport/grpc/transport.go:97 with the one added method at internal/transport/grpc/transport.go:115, plus app-owned DTOs. The app operation internal/app/facade/message_files.go:79 depends only on the pre-existing telegramRepo partial interface GetMessage at internal/app/facade/service.go:18-19; the concrete implementation is internal/infra/telegram/client_adapter.go:138 GetMessage, which already routes through withChatReady and FloodWaitFromError. The default choice reuses the unchanged pure resolver resolveMessageFile at internal/app/facade/file_download.go:69.
module_and_spec_responsibility: internal/app/facade/message_files.go carries the sole application responsibility: resolve one GetMessage snapshot into MessageFiles/MessageMediaItem/MessageFileDescriptor DTOs and apply the design section 5-6 grouping/order/metadata rules. It imports only context and go-tdlib client; no protobuf or transport import.

internal/transport/grpc/message_files.go carries the sole transport responsibility: ID validation, the per-handler Canceled/DeadlineExceeded mapping in mapListMessageFilesError (message_files.go:16-24), delegation to the unchanged mapFacadeError, and explicit DTO-to-proto mapping. It performs no media extraction.

internal/infra/telegram is unchanged and does not know enumeration DTOs. No new repository method, listener, worker, channel or business-update subscriber was added, consistent with .trellis/spec/backend/telegram-tdlib-guidelines.md and design.md sections 3 and 10.

spec_conformance_summary: Conforms to the locked ruler (design SHA256 6f99747c01261442760108e8377199410eea48e535980a8918e74b41b1849059, PRD 8d0dd16fa2a12420d635cd044c8b21c8a2bdf31a4051693d8eaaa062bb5068a7), both recomputed this round. design section 4: the proto declarations match the design block by name, field number and enum value; exactly one unary RPC is added, and the generated grpc bindings diff is purely additive while the pb.go regeneration only shifts descriptor indices. review/preflight-evidence.md records the descriptor comparison as the 17 legacy RPCs, 38 legacy messages and 1 legacy enum unchanged. design sections 5-6: one GetMessage snapshot, echoed IDs, int64(msg.MediaAlbumId), no sibling lookup, one item for ordinary content, per-slot items for paid media, FILES_PRESENT/NO_FILES/LOCKED/UNSUPPORTED states, nil and Id<=0 omission with original source indices, no sorting, duplicate occurrences preserved with (item_index, role, source_index) identity, paired alternative/HLS source indices, section 6 emission order and metadata sources per content kind, size only from File.Size>0, dimensions clamped at 0, photo MIME image/jpeg, empty filename/MIME for thumbnail/cover/alternative/premium, and default only when resolveMessageFile's positive ID occurs in emitted entries. design section 7: ctx is checked before and after the single GetMessage and before return; repository errors pass through unchanged; nil message yields the existing NewMessageNotFoundError; no new repository method or SDK call; transport validates IDs before the app call and returns InvalidArgument; Canceled/DeadlineExceeded are mapped locally for this handler only, everything else delegates to mapFacadeError including FloodWait RetryInfo, ChatNotReady RetryInfo, and Internal for raw ResponseError; no errors are converted to empty success. design sections 8 and 10: legacy RPCs, field numbers, stream flags, the global mapper, the streaming event helpers, the download engine, infra/telegram and all old test files are unchanged; the changed tracked files are confined to facade.proto, the two generated bindings, transport.go facadeService plus the synced mock, and docs/TEST-MATRIX.md, together with the four new untracked source/test files. api/proto/facade.proto remains the same symlink. No new repository method, listener, worker, channel, background download, update subscription, recursive SDK traversal, download-engine change or TDLib upgrade was introduced.
test_assertion_review: No tracked *_test.go file was modified or deleted (git status shows only production/mock/doc files plus the four new untracked files; internal/app/facade/file_download_test.go and internal/transport/grpc/file_download_test.go and transport_test.go do not appear in the changed set), so no old assertion was deleted or weakened and the A4 progressive green-red-green gate is preserved. New app tests (internal/app/facade/message_files_test.go, 15 top-level / 36 with subtests) are table-driven and use the strict mockery TelegramRepo with only GetMessage expected: unexpected DownloadFile/GetFile/GetFileDownloadedPrefixSize/ReadFilePart calls would fail, encoding A1 metadata-only. They assert literal ordered descriptors (IDs, roles, source_index, file name, MIME, codec, size/size_known, width/height, photo size type) rather than recomputing from production code, and they encode the locked design choices: three photo sizes including default 103 by largest File.Size, four video descriptors with paired alternative/HLS sharing source_index 1, all eight ordinary types plus typed-nil, paid photo+video+preview+unsupported plus nil/typed-nil slots preserving item indices, two paid items as separate groups, duplicate IDs across roles, Id<=0/nil references omitted, Size=0 with ExpectedSize>0 staying unknown, text/nil/other content unsupported versus supported-empty photo, album ID copied with a single strict GetMessage and no sibling calls, repeat enumeration equal, and context checked before/after/after-error with nil message mapping to MessageNotFoundError template and upstream errors preserved. A5's duplicate-ID fixture exercises duplicates across roles within one video item, not across two separate paid items, but the extractor additionally has no cross-item dedup path, so this is a coverage nit rather than a behavioral gap. New transport tests (internal/transport/grpc/message_files_test.go, 6 top-level / 12 with subtests): validation cases rely on an un-stubbed strict FacadeService mock, so a single app call would fail the test (InvalidArgument before the app call); mapping asserts literal proto fields and enum values; error mapping covers cancel/deadline/NotFound/FloodWait ResourceExhausted with exact RetryInfo delay/ChatNotReady Unavailable with the existing 2s RetryInfo/raw ResponseError Internal; the two real bufconn A3 flows call the registered server's ListMessageFiles, parse the returned descriptors, select a non-default photo size and an alternative-video file, assert role/source_index/codec and non-default identity, keep the download gate closed until the explicit DownloadFile RPC, require metadata identity/size then offset-0 non-empty payload with upstream_complete=false before the completion barrier is opened, and require exactly one terminal complete of the exact size followed by clean EOF and concatenated payload equality; assertReceivedDownload rejects metadata after the first event, noncontiguous offsets and post-complete events. Runtime red evidence is main's, recorded in review/linux-validation.md (native focused package tests, full internal suite, vet, existing streaming green-red-green, both A3 synchronous-starter mutants and the enumeration omission mutant), and is not treated here as architecture evidence. docs/TEST-MATRIX.md records the static inventory 36->51 and 65->71 (529->550 displayed rows) consistent with the new test files.
